title: The CPU, memory and storage: 8 questions
subject: Computing
source: Written for computing/y11 lesson 30 (Pupil PDF worksheet: 8 hardware and storage questions)

questions.q: Name the three buses in a computer.
questions.a: Address bus, data bus, control bus

questions.q: What does the arithmetic logic unit (ALU) do?
questions.a: Carries out arithmetic (e.g. addition) and logic operations (e.g. comparisons)

questions.q: What is the purpose of the program counter?
questions.a: It holds the address of the next instruction to be fetched

questions.q: Describe the fetch stage of the fetch-decode-execute cycle.
questions.a: The address in the PC is copied to the MAR and sent on the address bus; the instruction at that address is sent on the data bus to the MDR; the PC is incremented

questions.q: Explain why a higher clock speed can improve performance.
questions.a: More cycles per second, so more instructions are carried out each second

questions.q: Give two differences between RAM and ROM.
questions.a: RAM is volatile, ROM is not; RAM can be written to, ROM is read-only; ROM holds the start-up (boot) instructions

questions.q: Compare solid state and magnetic storage.
questions.a: Solid state: faster access, no moving parts, more robust, lower capacity for the price. Magnetic: cheaper per gigabyte, larger capacity, slower, moving parts

questions.q: Which type of storage is best for a camera's memory card? Give a reason.
questions.a: Solid state (flash): small, light, robust because it has no moving parts
